protocol.regimes: Available T0 original-data, T1 mixed-data scratch and T3 frozen-encoder initialization checkpoints; Delay uses three native-H7 T1 models. No T2 checkpoints in this diagnostic.
protocol.selection: Six fixed Speed scenes (one per evaluation seed); sixteen deterministic source queries per other task, all retained. Delay has eight up/eight down; Cube has four queries per action anchor.
protocol.candidate_bank: Common per scene and hidden condition. Native amplitude/persistence/braking and task-specific alternatives; Speed includes goal-aligned amplitudes, Portal includes transverse exit corrections, Cube includes grip controls. No model-score-based query/goal selection.
protocol.goals: Condition0 native5-step goal except Speed32px goal and Delay delay0 native15-step goal; same goal for every hidden condition.

costs.pusht: Euclidean joint agent/block position and wrapped angle*40 distance (px-equivalent)

protocol.fixed_deadline: Costs measured at fixed block endpoints, not first passage; comparisons of earlier endpoints do not claim continuous trajectory safety.
protocol.refresh: free autoregression; full true current+past input; current true current only; past true earlier window only. Refresh receives privileged future evidence and is not an executable policy.
protocol.decision_gap: min_c mean_k J(k,c) - mean_k min_c J(k,c); finite common candidate bank, never a global control optimum
protocol.model_advantage: decision_gap - matched_model_regret; positive beats the best single plan shared by conditions
protocol.aggregation: Within source query equal condition weight; across source queries equal weight. Error ratios use summed errors. 4000 paired source-query bootstrap samples, seed20260930.
protocol.cube_observations: All histories, shared query, goal and candidate futures freshly rendered with one simulator+JPEG95 codec. Controlled source positions agree within1e-6m; fresh native future/query pixel identity checked. Frozen benchmark data unchanged.

limitations: fixed candidate bank, not CEM or global optimal control
small deterministic diagnostic panels, not replacement benchmark scores
true-observation refresh supplies privileged future evidence and is not an executable policy
refresh improvement does not distinguish numerical accumulation from renewed dynamics evidence
no-training measurements cannot establish whether more parameters or longer trained context is necessary
All 70 cells refer to selected existing checkpoints, not new training repetitions or the benchmark aggregate.
No nine-task closed-loop CEM evaluation in this diagnostic.
Raw panels and full checkpoints remain local; public hashes and aggregates do not yet constitute a full external reproduction package.
